question.text: Portfolio standard deviation is 15%. Per normal distribution, approximately what % of returns fall within ±1 sigma (mean ±15%)?

explanation.text: The Logic: Normal distribution: ~68% within 1 SD, ~95% within 2 SD, ~99% within 3 SD. The Trap: 95% is within 2 SD; 99% is within 3 SD. Cross-Exam Context: Core stats across XV, X-A, XXI-B. Manager's Pro-Tip: Real return distributions have fatter tails — don't rely on normal approximations for tail-risk estimation.
